title: The Secretary's Secret

beats.text: In nineteen thirty-five, Grace Groner spent one hundred eighty dollars on her company's stock.
She worked there as a secretary for forty-three years.
She bought her clothes at rummage sales,
and walked everywhere instead of buying a car.
Her stock? She never sold a single share.
The dividends went right back in, year after year.
When she died at one hundred,
that one-hundred-eighty-dollar stake had grown to seven million dollars.
She left it to her old college, to fund study abroad.
She never needed to look rich.

caption:
In 1935 Grace Groner put $180 into her employer's stock. She never sold, reinvested the dividends and lived simply.

When she died at 100, she left about $7 million to Lake Forest College.
